cases.task: Choose how a dashboard should handle an SSE ready frame with id=10 after its previous connection had advanced an in-memory cursor to 900. The operator intentionally entered after_sequence=10 to replay history.

required_facts.text: The ready frame belongs to a newly created EventSource connection and carries the server-accepted resume cursor.
A monotonic comparison against the prior connection's cursor 900 would reject all progress below 900.
Event and page frames after ready must remain monotonic within the new connection.
